feature.title: 🚀 Feature: Settlement PDF export
feature.body:
## Bounded Context
Settlement domain. Merchant actor. Reads from settlement records; no write side effects.

## User Stories

### Story 1: Export settlement history as a PDF

- As a **Merchant**, I want **to export my settlement history as a PDF** so that **I can satisfy my accounting and audit needs**

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Merchants can trigger a PDF download of their settlement history
- [ ] The PDF includes a header with the Merchant name, export date, and date range
- [ ] An empty result set produces a PDF with headers and a 'No settlements found' message
- [ ] Only Merchants with the settlement.export permission can trigger an export

#### Scenarios

```gherkin
Scenario: Merchant downloads a settlement PDF
  Given a Merchant with the settlement.export permission has settlements in the selected date range
  When the Merchant triggers a PDF export
  Then the Merchant receives a PDF of the settlement history for that range

Scenario: PDF header shows Merchant name and date range
  Given a Merchant has triggered a PDF export
  When the export completes
  Then the PDF header shows the Merchant name, the export date, and the selected date range

Scenario: Empty settlement range produces a placeholder PDF
  Given a Merchant has no settlements in the selected date range
  When the Merchant triggers a PDF export
  Then the PDF shows 'No settlements found' with the headers intact

Scenario: Merchant without export permission sees no export action
  Given a Merchant without the settlement.export permission
  When the Merchant views the settlement history
  Then no export action is available
```

## Domain Events

- Emits: `SettlementExportRequested`, `SettlementExportReady`
- Consumes: none

## Trace Plan

1. [x] ☄️ Skeleton — Export settlement history as a PDF: proves the export path end-to-end (claims: "Merchant downloads a settlement PDF") #56
2. [ ] ☄️ Deepening — Export settlement history as a PDF: header, empty range, and permission gate (claims: "PDF header shows Merchant name and date range", "Empty settlement range produces a placeholder PDF", "Merchant without export permission sees no export action")
